The New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) “Part 575 – Invasive Species Regulations” contains a list of **prohibited plant species**. The list is presented in the PDF document *islist.pdf* (August 2014) under the heading “Prohibited” in the “PLANTS” section. The prohibited species are:

|-----------------|-------------|
| Acer pseudoplatanus | Sycamore Maple |
